description: The bar chart illustrates accuracy values for three annotation tools across two tweet-related categories. The category axis is horizontal and shows two labeled groups: “Emoji Tweets” on the left and “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis” on the right; the labels are angled, and there is no indication that the categories are sorted beyond their left-to-right placement. The value axis is labeled “Accuracy” and appears on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 up to 0.8, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each category contains three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: TEXTBLOB (white bar with a black outline), VADER (white bar with diagonal black hatching), and ChatGPT (solid green bar). For “Emoji Tweets,” the TEXTBLOB bar reaches roughly 0.4 accuracy, the VADER hatched bar is around 0.6, and the green ChatGPT bar is near 0.8. For “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis,” the TEXTBLOB bar is around 0.6, the VADER hatched bar is slightly above that (approximately 0.65), and the green ChatGPT bar extends to about 0.85, slightly above the top tick shown. The bars are grouped side-by-side within each category (not stacked), and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct green fill used for ChatGPT and the hatch pattern used for VADER.
